```{shinylive-python}
            ui.input_select(

                "Preference Preset",
                {
                    "community_balanced": "Community-balanced (28% Acc, 20% Contig, 17% Res, 35% Repl)",
                    "complete_replicon_recovery": "Complete-replicon-recovery (Gate: all replicons ≥95%)",
                    "sequence_accurate_assembly": "Sequence-accurate-assembly (50% Acc, 14% Contig, 12% Res, 24% Repl)",
                    "custom": "Custom Priorities"
                },

        ui.output_ui("shortlist_content")
    ),

    # Region 4: Selected Detail
    ui.tags.section(

    # Region 5: Concise Methodology
    ui.tags.section(
        {"id": "region-methodology", "role": "region", "aria-labelledby": "heading-methodology", "class": "region-container"},

        ui.tags.p(
            "Scoring Specification 1.0 evaluates four fixed 0–100 criterion scales without dynamic min–max rescaling: "
            "(1) Reference-aware contiguity via symmetric distance from auNGA ratio 1.0; "
            "(2) Sequence accuracy via combined mismatch-plus-indel event rate (0 at ≥10 events/100kbp); "
            "(3) Residual adapter/barcode removal via cohort clean-isolate percentage; "
            "(4) Reference-replicon recovery via cohort absolute count of replicons <50% coverage with fixed denominator 3."
        ),
        ui.tags.p(
            ui.tags.a(
                "Full Methodology & Robustness Specification →",
                href="docs/qc-trimming-recommendation-system-specification.md",
                target="_blank"
            )
        ),
        ui.tags.div(
            {"class": "provenance-box"},
            ui.tags.strong("Scoring Version: "), "1.0 | ",
            ui.tags.strong("Source Repository: "), "adimascf/biox7021 | ",
            ui.tags.strong("Pinned Commit: "), "4d6b8cb1d482e5066f9ca575ebd3b67af4a32562 | ",
            ui.tags.strong("Benchmark Scope & Limitations: "),
            "Evaluated on 13 reference bacterial isolates across 17 QC–trimming combinations (884 observations). "
            "Scores represent preference-alignment trade-offs on this benchmark cohort and are not universal assembly quality indicators. "
            "No qualitative evaluation labels, rating tiers, or subjective categories are assigned."
        )
    )
)

def server(input, output, session):

    show_all = reactive.Value(False)

    @reactive.Effect
    @reactive.event(input.btn_reveal_all)
    def _toggle_show_all():
        show_all.set(not show_all.get())

    @reactive.Effect
    @reactive.event(input.preset_select)
    def _apply_preset():
        p = input.preset_select()
        if p == "community_balanced":
            ui.update_numeric("w_acc", value=28)
            ui.update_numeric("w_cont", value=20)
            ui.update_numeric("w_res", value=17)
            ui.update_numeric("w_rep", value=35)
            ui.update_checkbox("gate_complete", value=False)
            ui.update_checkbox("gate_zero_hits", value=False)
        elif p == "complete_replicon_recovery":
            ui.update_numeric("w_acc", value=43)
            ui.update_numeric("w_cont", value=31)
            ui.update_numeric("w_res", value=26)
            ui.update_numeric("w_rep", value=0)
            ui.update_checkbox("gate_complete", value=True)
            ui.update_checkbox("gate_zero_hits", value=False)
        elif p == "sequence_accurate_assembly":
            ui.update_numeric("w_acc", value=50)
            ui.update_numeric("w_cont", value=14)
            ui.update_numeric("w_res", value=12)
            ui.update_numeric("w_rep", value=24)
            ui.update_checkbox("gate_complete", value=False)
            ui.update_checkbox("gate_zero_hits", value=False)

    @reactive.Calc
    def load_metrics_data():
        try:
            from pyodide.http import open_url
            try:
                return pd.read_csv(open_url("assets/data/assembly_metrics.csv"))
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                return pd.read_csv(open_url("logbook/assembly_metrics.csv"))
            except Exception:
                pass
            pinned_url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/adimascf/biox7021/4d6b8cb1d482e5066f9ca575ebd3b67af4a32562/logbook/assembly_metrics.csv"
            return pd.read_csv(open_url(pinned_url))
        except ImportError:
            for path in [
                "assets/data/assembly_metrics.csv",
                "logbook/assembly_metrics.csv",
                "assembly_metrics.csv"
            ]:
                try:
                    return pd.read_csv(path)
                except Exception:
                    continue
            raise FileNotFoundError("Could not find assembly_metrics.csv in local paths")

    @reactive.Calc
    def weights_valid():
        w1 = input.w_acc() or 0
        w2 = input.w_cont() or 0
        w3 = input.w_res() or 0
        w4 = input.w_rep() or 0
        if w1 < 0 or w2 < 0 or w3 < 0 or w4 < 0:
            return False
        total = w1 + w2 + w3 + w4
        return total == 100 and total > 0

    @output
    @render.ui
    def scenario_validation_msg():
        m = input.model_select()
        d = input.depth_select()
        if not m or not d:
            return ui.HTML("<div class='alert alert-info' role='alert'><strong>Notice:</strong> Please select both a basecalling model and sequencing depth to view recommendations. (Selections begin unset.)</div>")
        return ui.HTML(f"<div class='alert alert-success' role='status'>Active Scenario: <strong>{m.upper()}</strong> basecalling at <strong>{d}</strong> depth.</div>")

    @output
    @render.ui
    def preset_description():
        p = input.preset_select()
        descriptions = {
            "community_balanced": "Community-balanced: 28% sequence accuracy, 20% reference contiguity, 17% residual removal, 35% replicon recovery.",
            "complete_replicon_recovery": "Complete-replicon-recovery: Enforces ≥95% coverage on all reference replicons; ranks eligible tools with 43% accuracy, 31% contiguity, 26% residual removal.",
            "sequence_accurate_assembly": "Sequence-accurate-assembly: Prioritizes base-level sequence fidelity with 50% accuracy weight.",
            "custom": "Custom Priorities: Specify your own percentage weights totaling 100% and toggle non-compensatory gates."
        }
        desc = descriptions.get(p, "")
        return ui.tags.div({"class": "alert alert-secondary", "style": "margin-bottom: 0; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.9rem;"}, desc)

    @output
    @render.ui
    def weight_total_indicator():
        w1 = input.w_acc() or 0
        w2 = input.w_cont() or 0
        w3 = input.w_res() or 0
        w4 = input.w_rep() or 0
        total = w1 + w2 + w3 + w4
        diff = total - 100
        if diff == 0:
            return ui.HTML("<div style='color: #16a34a; font-size: 0.9rem; margin-top: 4px;'>✓ Total: <strong>100%</strong></div>")
        elif diff < 0:
            return ui.HTML(f"<div style='color: #dc2626; font-size: 0.9rem; margin-top: 4px;'>⚠ Total: <strong>{total}%</strong> ({abs(diff)}% remaining to allocate) — <em>Ranking paused</em></div>")
        else:
            return ui.HTML(f"<div style='color: #dc2626; font-size: 0.9rem; margin-top: 4px;'>⚠ Total: <strong>{total}%</strong> ({diff}% above 100%) — <em>Ranking paused</em></div>")

    @reactive.Calc
    def evaluated_results():
        m = input.model_select()
        d = input.depth_select()
        if not m or not d or not weights_valid():
            return [], []

        df = load_metrics_data()
        subset = df[(df["model"] == m) & (df["depth"] == d)]

        gate_complete = input.gate_complete()
        gate_zero_hits = input.gate_zero_hits()

        w_acc = (input.w_acc() or 0) / 100.0
        w_cont = (input.w_cont() or 0) / 100.0
        w_res = (input.w_res() or 0) / 100.0
        w_rep = (input.w_rep() or 0) / 100.0

        eligible_records = []
        excluded_records = []

        for combo, grp in subset.groupby("combo"):
            mean_cont = float(np.mean(np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - np.abs(grp["auNGA_ratio"] - 1.0)) * 100.0))
            mean_acc = float(np.mean(np.clip(1.0 - (grp["Mismatches per 100kbp"] + grp["Indels per 100kbp"]) / 10.0, 0.0, 1.0) * 100.0))
            clean_pct = float(np.mean(grp["contamination_count"] == 0) * 100.0)
            t_hits = int(grp["contamination_count"].sum())
            clean_isolates = int((grp["contamination_count"] == 0).sum())
            affected_residual_isolates = int((grp["contamination_count"] > 0).sum())
            t_miss = int(grp["total_missed"].sum())
            full_missed = int(grp["full_missed"].sum())
            partial_missed = int(grp["partial_missed"].sum())
            affected_replicon_isolates = int((grp["total_missed"] > 0).sum())
            score_rep = float(max(0.0, 1.0 - t_miss / 3.0) * 100.0)

            mean_error_rate = float(np.mean(grp["Mismatches per 100kbp"] + grp["Indels per 100kbp"]))
            mean_mismatches = float(np.mean(grp["Mismatches per 100kbp"]))
            mean_indels = float(np.mean(grp["Indels per 100kbp"]))
            mean_aunga = float(np.mean(grp["auNGA_ratio"]))

            overall_score = (w_acc * mean_acc + w_cont * mean_cont + w_res * clean_pct + w_rep * score_rep)

            is_eligible = True
            reasons = []

            if gate_complete and t_miss > 0:
                is_eligible = False
                reasons.append("fails complete-recovery gate (<95% coverage on at least one replicon)")

            if gate_zero_hits and t_hits > 0:
                is_eligible = False
                reasons.append(f"fails zero-residual-hits gate ({t_hits} hit(s) detected)")

            # Warnings
            warnings = []
            if t_hits > 0:
                warnings.append(f"{t_hits} residual hit(s) across {affected_residual_isolates} isolate(s)")
            if t_miss > 0:
                warnings.append(f"{t_miss} missed replicon(s) across {affected_replicon_isolates} isolate(s) ({full_missed} full, {partial_missed} partial)")

            iso_acc = np.clip(1.0 - (grp["Mismatches per 100kbp"] + grp["Indels per 100kbp"]) / 10.0, 0.0, 1.0) * 100.0
            if (mean_acc - float(np.min(iso_acc))) >= 25.0:
                warnings.append("Variable sequence accuracy across isolates (lowest isolate is ≥25 pts below mean)")

            iso_cont = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - np.abs(grp["auNGA_ratio"] - 1.0)) * 100.0
            if (mean_cont - float(np.min(iso_cont))) >= 25.0:
                warnings.append("Variable contiguity across isolates (lowest isolate is ≥25 pts below mean)")

            item = {
                "combo": str(combo),
                "overall_score": overall_score,
                "display_score": round(overall_score, 1),
                "contiguity": round(mean_cont, 1),
                "accuracy": round(mean_acc, 1),
                "residual": round(clean_pct, 1),
                "replicon": round(score_rep, 1),
                "mean_error_rate": mean_error_rate,
                "mean_mismatches": mean_mismatches,
                "mean_indels": mean_indels,
                "mean_aunga": mean_aunga,
                "t_hits": t_hits,
                "clean_isolates": clean_isolates,
                "affected_residual_isolates": affected_residual_isolates,
                "t_miss": t_miss,
                "full_missed": full_missed,
                "partial_missed": partial_missed,
                "affected_replicon_isolates": affected_replicon_isolates,
                "reasons": reasons,
                "warnings": warnings,
                "is_near_tie": False,
                "raw_group": grp,
            }

            if is_eligible:
                eligible_records.append(item)
            else:
                excluded_records.append(item)

        # Sort eligible by full precision overall_score descending, then combo
        eligible_records.sort(key=lambda r: (-r["overall_score"], r["combo"]))

        # Competition ranking
        for idx, rec in enumerate(eligible_records):
            if idx == 0:
                rec["rank"] = 1
            else:
                prev = eligible_records[idx - 1]
                if abs(rec["overall_score"] - prev["overall_score"]) < 1e-9:
                    rec["rank"] = prev["rank"]
                else:
                    rec["rank"] = idx + 1

        # Near tie calculation
        for idx in range(len(eligible_records) - 1):
            if abs(eligible_records[idx]["overall_score"] - eligible_records[idx + 1]["overall_score"]) < 1.0:
                eligible_records[idx]["is_near_tie"] = True
                eligible_records[idx + 1]["is_near_tie"] = True

        return eligible_records, excluded_records

    @output
    @render.ui
    def shortlist_content():
        m = input.model_select()
        d = input.depth_select()
        if not m or not d:
            return ui.HTML("<div class='alert alert-info' role='status'><strong>Notice:</strong> Please select both a basecalling model and sequencing depth in step 1 to view recommendations. (Selections begin unset.)</div>")

        if not weights_valid():
            return ui.HTML("<div class='alert alert-warning' role='alert'><strong>Ranking paused:</strong> Allocation must total exactly 100% before recommendations can be evaluated.</div>")

        eligible, excluded = evaluated_results()
        if not eligible and not excluded:
            return ui.HTML("<p class='text-muted'>No benchmark data found for this scenario.</p>")

        limit = len(eligible) if show_all.get() else 5
        displayed_eligible = eligible[:limit]
        btn_label = "Show Top 5 Only" if show_all.get() else "Reveal All 17 Combinations"

        table_rows = []
        for r in displayed_eligible:
            near_tie_html = '<br><span class="near-tie-badge">similar score (&lt;1.0)</span>' if r["is_near_tie"] else ""

            warnings_html = ""
            if r["warnings"]:
                w_items = "".join(f"<li>{w}</li>" for w in r["warnings"])
                warnings_html = f"<ul class='list-unstyled mb-0 small text-danger' style='font-size: 0.8rem;'>{w_items}</ul>"
            else:
                warnings_html = "<span class='text-success small' style='font-size: 0.8rem;'>✓ Clean</span>"

            row_html = f"""
            <tr>
                <td class='text-center fw-bold'>{r['rank']}</td>
                <td><strong>{r['combo']}</strong></td>
                <td class='text-center'><strong style='font-size: 1.05rem;'>{r['display_score']}</strong>{near_tie_html}</td>
                <td>
                    <div class='fw-bold'>{r['accuracy']}</div>
                    <div class='text-muted small' style='font-size: 0.8rem;'>{r['mean_error_rate']:.2f} err/100kbp<br>({r['mean_mismatches']:.2f} mm, {r['mean_indels']:.2f} indel)</div>
                </td>
                <td>
                    <div class='fw-bold'>{r['contiguity']}</div>
                    <div class='text-muted small' style='font-size: 0.8rem;'>auNGA: {r['mean_aunga']:.3f}</div>
                </td>
                <td>
                    <div class='fw-bold'>{r['residual']}</div>
                    <div class='text-muted small' style='font-size: 0.8rem;'>{r['t_hits']} hit(s) ({r['clean_isolates']}/13 clean)</div>
                </td>
                <td>
                    <div class='fw-bold'>{r['replicon']}</div>
                    <div class='text-muted small' style='font-size: 0.8rem;'>{r['t_miss']} missed ({r['full_missed']} full, {r['partial_missed']} partial)</div>
                </td>
                <td>{warnings_html}</td>
            </tr>
            """
            table_rows.append(row_html)

        tbody_html = "".join(table_rows)

        # Build excluded section
        n_excluded = len(excluded)
        if n_excluded == 0:
            excluded_html = "<details style='margin-top: 18px;'><summary style='cursor: pointer; font-weight: 500; color: #475569;'>Excluded / Ineligible Combinations (0)</summary><p style='margin-top: 8px; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #64748b;'>All evaluated combinations are currently eligible under active criteria.</p></details>"
        else:
            ex_items = "".join(f"<li><strong>{r['combo']}</strong>: {'; '.join(r['reasons'])}</li>" for r in excluded)
            excluded_html = f"<details style='margin-top: 18px;'><summary style='cursor: pointer; font-weight: 500; color: #dc2626;'>Excluded / Ineligible Combinations ({n_excluded})</summary><ul style='margin-top: 8px; font-size: 0.9rem;'>{ex_items}</ul></details>"

        return ui.HTML(f"""
            <div style='margin-bottom: 12px;'>
                <button id='btn_reveal_all' type='button' class='btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary action-button'>{btn_label}</button>
            </div>
            <div class='table-responsive'>
                <table class='table table-hover table-striped table-bordered ranking-table align-middle' aria-label='Recommendation Shortlist'>
                    <thead>
                        <tr>
                            <th scope='col' class='text-center' style='width: 6%;'>Rank</th>
                            <th scope='col' style='width: 16%;'>Combination</th>
                            <th scope='col' class='text-center' style='width: 12%;'>Preference Score</th>
                            <th scope='col' style='width: 17%;'>Sequence Accuracy</th>
                            <th scope='col' style='width: 15%;'>Reference Contiguity</th>
                            <th scope='col' style='width: 16%;'>Residual Removal</th>
                            <th scope='col' style='width: 18%;'>Replicon Recovery</th>
                            <th scope='col'>Diagnostics</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                        {tbody_html}
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
            {excluded_html}
        """)

    @output
    @render.ui
    def selected_combo_detail():
        m = input.model_select()
        d = input.depth_select()
        if not m or not d:
            return ui.HTML("<div class='text-muted' style='font-size: 0.95rem; font-style: italic;'>Select a scenario in step 1 to inspect per-isolate evidence and diagnostics.</div>")

        eligible, _ = evaluated_results()
        if not eligible:
            return ui.HTML("<div class='text-muted'>No eligible combinations under current criteria.</div>")

        # Display details for the leading combination
        leader = eligible[0]
        grp = leader["raw_group"]

        iso_rows = []
        for _, row in grp.iterrows():
            sample_name = row["sample"]
            aunga = row["auNGA_ratio"]
            cont_score = max(0.0, 1.0 - abs(aunga - 1.0)) * 100.0
            err_rate = row["Mismatches per 100kbp"] + row["Indels per 100kbp"]
            acc_score = max(0.0, min(1.0, 1.0 - err_rate / 10.0)) * 100.0
            res_hits = row["contamination_count"]
            missed_rep = row["total_missed"]
            cov_str = str(row.get("all_contigs_coverage", ""))

            iso_rows.append(f"""
                <tr>
                    <td><code>{sample_name}</code></td>
                    <td>{aunga:.3f} (score {cont_score:.1f})</td>
                    <td>{err_rate:.2f} ({row['Mismatches per 100kbp']:.2f} mm, {row['Indels per 100kbp']:.2f} indel; score {acc_score:.1f})</td>
                    <td>{res_hits} hit(s)</td>
                    <td>{missed_rep} missed</td>
                    <td class='small text-muted' style='font-size: 0.75rem;'>{cov_str}</td>
                </tr>
            """)

        iso_tbody = "".join(iso_rows)

        return ui.HTML(f"""
            <div style='background-color: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 14px 16px; margin-bottom: 16px;'>
                <h4 style='margin-top: 0; font-size: 1.1rem; color: #0f172a;'>
                    Leading Combination: <strong>{leader['combo']}</strong> (Rank {leader['rank']}, Preference Score: {leader['display_score']})
                </h4>
                <div style='font-size: 0.9rem; color: #475569;'>
                    Contiguity: <strong>{leader['contiguity']}</strong> (mean auNGA: {leader['mean_aunga']:.3f}) |
                    Accuracy: <strong>{leader['accuracy']}</strong> ({leader['mean_error_rate']:.2f} err/100kbp) |
                    Residual Removal: <strong>{leader['residual']}%</strong> ({leader['t_hits']} hit(s)) |
                    Replicon Recovery: <strong>{leader['replicon']}</strong> ({leader['t_miss']} missed)
                </div>
            </div>
            <h5 style='font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: #334155; margin-bottom: 8px;'>Per-Isolate Breakdown (13 Reference Isolates):</h5>
            <div class='table-responsive'>
                <table class='table table-sm table-bordered' style='font-size: 0.85rem;' aria-label='Per-isolate details'>
                    <thead style='background-color: #f1f5f9;'>
                        <tr>
                            <th>Isolate</th>
                            <th>auNGA Ratio</th>
                            <th>Errors per 100kbp</th>
                            <th>Residual Hits</th>
                            <th>Missed Replicons</th>
                            <th>Coverage Summary</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                        {iso_tbody}
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        """)

app = App(app_ui, server)
```
